items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Then he disappeared, and I went back down to Tier 1 and worked for Syl Stewart.

ctx.x: Most of your jobs down at Leech Lake?

No, just all over. We worked in several theaters around there. They used to get a little group together in like a vaudeville. You know how you gig. It was mostly gigging. Then he disappeared, and I went back down to Tier 1 and worked for Syl Stewart. Through Jelly Roll, he got me the job. I worked down there just a clarinet and piano.

I remember Dink told me once about one job. He was mad about Jelly. Dink claimed he got the job at a hotel, the richest hotel, I believe, in San Diego. And Jelly would go in and always insist on crossing his legs on each leg. The boss didn't like that and told him not to do it. And Jelly said, well, I crossed my legs in all the best places in Europe and America, I'm going to keep on, and the boss fired him the next night.
